description: This file contains utility functions for file property reading, file content reading, file type checking, recursive file search, and string property expansion within a 'Utils' namespace. It provides support for configuration parsing, file system operations, and string processing related to file handling.

methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file with support for recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching a pattern within given directory paths, respecting exclusions and a maximum number of results.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive search for files starting from a directory path, with depth limits and exclusions.

methods.description: Processes a string to replace variable placeholders (prefixed with '$') with their actual property values read from a specified file.
